DTF Press on Hoodie vs T-Shirt — 165C vs 180C Temperature Guide for Printers

Sale91 pressing guide:
• Patli T-shirt: 165°C, 5 second
• Hoodie / sweatshirt: 180°C, 5 second
• Dono par medium-firm pressure
Poora thanda hone do, film dheere se peel karo (cold peel), phir Teflon sheet ya baking paper rakh kar 5 second aur press karo. Yeh hamare DTF prints ki settings hain — doosri film aur press alag ho sakte hain, isliye pehle ek extra kapde par test karo.

Comment mein batao, zyada hoodie par print karwate ho ya T-shirt par? 👇
